overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused multi-platform academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His audience is highly receptive to research milestones, tool releases (such as CooRnet v2.0), grant announcements, and academic hiring opportunities, yielding strong engagement rates across all channels.

contentThemes.description: Updates on newly published papers, research grants, and methodological approaches to studying online disinformation.
Announcements regarding updates to computational tools like CooRnet for detecting coordinated link sharing.
Postings for PhD students and postdoctoral researcher positions in computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-post engaging visual elements or summaries of publications to boost interaction on text-heavy platforms.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn, where audience volume is highest and research milestone posts achieve high absolute reach.
Engage directly with replies and comments, especially on hiring posts, to amplify algorithm-driven post reach.

platformInsights.bluesky: Achieves the highest relative engagement rate (avg ~6.14%), driven heavily by reposts on research announcements and PhD recruitment posts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides strong interaction around specific tool updates and methodological debates within the niche academic community.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest overall volume of likes and comments (e.g., 107 engagements on the grant announcement), making it best suited for career and institutional news.
